seoTitle: How to Add a GIF to Shopify Product Descriptions
metaDescription: Add animated GIFs to your Shopify product descriptions and homepage to boost engagement and grab customer attention.
intro: A well-placed GIF can make a product page or homepage feel more dynamic than static images alone. This guide covers how to add GIFs to your Shopify product descriptions and homepage sections to increase customer engagement.

steps.heading: Prepare your GIF file
steps.body: Have your GIF ready and optimized so it isn't too large, which could slow down page loading.

steps.heading: Add a GIF to a product description
steps.body: Open the product editor, insert the GIF into the description field the same way you'd add a regular image.

steps.heading: Add a GIF to the homepage
steps.body: Use a homepage section or rich text block in your theme customizer to place the GIF where you want it displayed.

steps.heading: Optimize for faster loading
steps.body: Compress the GIF or keep its file size reasonable so it doesn't slow down your store's page speed.

steps.heading: Preview across devices
steps.body: Check how the GIF displays on both desktop and mobile before publishing your changes.

faq.question: Will a GIF slow down my Shopify store?
faq.answer: It can if the file size is large, so it's important to compress or optimize the GIF before uploading it.

faq.question: Can I add a GIF the same way I add a regular image?
faq.answer: Yes, Shopify treats GIFs like standard image files, so you can upload and insert them using the same image tools.

faq.question: Do GIFs work in all Shopify themes?
faq.answer: Most themes support GIFs in rich text and image blocks, though display behavior can vary slightly depending on the theme.

faq.question: Is there a file size limit for GIFs on Shopify?
faq.answer: Shopify has upload size limits for media files, so very large GIFs may need to be compressed before they can be uploaded.
